name: Dialogue Pass
description: Declarative preset for a dialogue-forward pass. Host application is not implemented.
purpose: Shape speech so subtext, status, and conflict carry more weight than exposition.
writing_goals: Reveal status through interruption, omission, and address
Keep exposition out of spoken lines unless a character would actually say it
Use beats and silence as pressure, not filler
constraints: Do not flatten all voices into one register
Do not use dialogue as a lore dump
Do not imitate a living author's speech patterns
checklist: Each speaker has a distinct aim
At least one line carries subtext
Attribution and beats support rhythm without crowding
The conversation changes a relationship or decision
